# Can Taste Be Owned in the Age of Generative AI? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-83877
Voiceover: A garment record becomes institutional evidence when material, date, maker, identifier, and rights remain attached.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Mary Tavener Holmes, 1983

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CO08-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · TASTE — What exactly is being claimed?. Separate a general sensibility from a named mark, protected work, registered design, confidential process, contractual promise, or misleading commercial representation. Precision prevents cultural grievance from being mistaken for a settled legal result.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO08-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · TRACE — What entered the process?. Keep a source log for references, licensed assets, model and tool versions, prompts, human selections, rejected outputs, edits, and final approvals. The record supports accountability without proving a legal conclusion on its own.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO08-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · TRANSFORM — Where is human judgment visible?. Describe the problem, constraints, alternatives, selection criteria, arrangement, revision, and final expressive choices. Avoid claiming that effort alone creates protection; the purpose is to preserve an accurate creative record.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO08-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · REVIEW — Which question needs counsel or permission?. Flag identifiable source works, living artists or houses named in prompts, confidential inputs, deceptive attribution, commercial marks, uncertain licenses, and jurisdiction-specific design questions for qualified review.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
